about_short_description.short_description: Harbera is a AI software for healthcare industry to monitors and proactively helps admin teams re-credential doctors.

product.name: AI Credentialing Software
product.description: Software that monitors and manages healthcare provider credentialing, tracking deadlines and compliance requirements across states and health plans.

product.name: AI-Powered Analytics
product.description: Analytics tool that provides insights into credentialing operations, revenue, and staffing trends within healthcare organizations.

product.name: Drag-and-Drop Data Entry
product.description: Feature that automates the ingestion and validation of provider documents using AI, reducing manual data entry.

product.name: One-Click Audit Preparation
product.description: Tool to instantly generate and export audit packets and rosters for providers or facilities in various formats.
